preconditions.description: The number of silos n is between 2 and 2000.
The number of scout groups k is between 1 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= c[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
preconditions.description: Each passage droid count ci,j is between -1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(c[i][j] == c[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
preconditions.description: Passages are bidirectional, so ci,j = cj,i.
No passage connects a silo with itself.

postconditions.description: The output is the average danger of the operations, rounded down to an integer.
